title: 중앙선거관리위원회 위원 수당 등에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1

full_text:
Article 5 (Allowance for Reviewing Agenda Items)
(1) An allowance for reviewing agenda items shall be paid to the Chairperson and non-standing members of the National Election Commission to support their activities in reviewing agenda items under Article 12 (1) 2 of the Act. <Amended on February 6, 2024>
(2) The allowance under paragraph (1) shall be 100,000 won per agenda item concerning matters for resolution and reports concerning major policies and pending issues among meeting agenda items under Article 11 (1) of the Enforcement Rules of the Election Commission Act. <Newly Inserted on February 6, 2024>
